home.heroLine2: Every Issue Has a Path to Action.
home.heroDesc: A secure, AI-assisted platform for citizens of Srikalahasti to report public-service issues — and for constituency staff to identify patterns, prioritize cases and coordinate responsible action.
home.howItWorksTitle: From Citizen Voice to Responsible Action
home.howItWorksSub: A transparent, predictable process for every submission.
home.step1Desc: Secure text, audio, or image submission. Identity optional.
home.step2Desc: Unique ID generated. Access restricted to authorized reviewers. Tracking code issued.
home.step5Desc: Department receives brief. MLA office monitors SLA.
home.leadershipBadge: Technology in Service of Public Responsibility
home.leadershipQuote: Proposed Platform Vision: Bringing transparent, accountable, and accessible governance to every citizen of Srikalahasti.
home.legacyQuote: A legacy remembered. A constituency reimagined.
home.securityDesc: Built with strict privacy, authentication, and role permissions.
home.securityItem1: Your complaint is visible only to authorized personnel assigned to review or act on it.
home.securityItem2: Access is protected by authentication, role permissions and audit logging.
home.securityItem3: Political branding does not control complaint priority, access or routing.
home.securityItem4: Uploaded evidence is not publicly displayed.

submit.title: Report a Public Service Issue
submit.subtitle: Your submission is private. Name and contact are never required.
submit.descPlaceholder: Describe clearly: what happened, what was the expected outcome vs what occurred. Be factual and specific — include dates, locations and roles where possible.
submit.mobilePurpose: Your mobile number is collected only to send your Complaint ID, status updates and clarification requests. It will not be publicly displayed or used for advertising.
submit.consentLabel: I consent to receive complaint-related SMS or WhatsApp updates.
submit.anonymous: I want to submit confidentially (no contact stored)
submit.anonNote: When checked, no mobile number or email is stored. You can still track via Complaint ID.
submit.evidenceNote: Photos, videos, audio, documents. Max 10MB each. Do not upload Aadhaar, PAN, bank details or sensitive personal data unrelated to this complaint.
submit.successNote: Save your Complaint ID and tracking token — you will need them to track this complaint.

track.title: Complaint Status Tracker
track.subtitle: Enter your Complaint ID or Tracking Token to see the current status.
track.hint: Your Complaint ID starts with SKT- and was shown on the submission receipt.
track.notFound: No complaint found with this ID or token. Please check and try again.
track.privacyNote: Only safe status information is shown here. Mobile numbers, reviewer identities and internal notes are never displayed.

about.title: A Civic-Technology Initiative for Srikalahasti
about.subtitle: This platform was designed and built as a proposed civic-technology initiative to connect citizen evidence, responsible AI analysis, and constituency-level public service coordination.
about.visionDesc: An AI-assisted citizen grievance and constituency intelligence platform for Srikalahasti Assembly Constituency (No. 168), Tirupati District, Andhra Pradesh.
about.aiRoleDesc: The AI layer structures, classifies and prioritizes. It does not judge. All AI outputs are preliminary assessments that require qualified human review before any action is taken.
about.privacyDesc: Citizens may submit anonymously. Evidence is not publicly displayed. Access is controlled by authentication, role permissions and audit logging.
about.safetyDesc: AI outputs must never declare guilt, accuse individuals, replace police investigation, or replace courts. Language is deliberately careful: credibility indicators, not truth determinations.
